headline: Why Orbit exists.
subheadline: AI coding tools made shipping fast. Knowing what a change broke did not get faster.

paragraphs: A pull request touches a few files. The question a reviewer actually has is which parts of the app a user would notice, and whether they still work. Writing and maintaining a browser suite to answer that is the work most small teams skip.

Orbit answers it from the code. It maps the app once, traces each diff to the journeys it can reach, and walks those in a real browser on the PR's preview. The result is one check on the PR, in plain English, with the evidence attached.
It is built to run on your infrastructure, with your model key, because the code and the credentials it needs are yours. The hosted version, when there is one, will be the same software run for you.

values.title: Show the work
values.description: Every verdict links to the recording, the step and the reason. A red check you cannot inspect is noise.

values.title: Test what changed
values.description: Most of a suite has nothing to do with a given PR. Scoping to the diff is what keeps a check fast and its failures meaningful.

values.title: Cost is visible
values.description: Model calls are counted per run, and passing steps replay without one. You should know what a check costs before you rely on it.
